g.title: work_loop
g.text: The work loop: do the action until its predicate holds; leave the trace; wake

g.title: wake
g.text: prints verdict, action or party, reason, predicate

g.title: waiting
g.text: the agent stops; the hooks print it and do not nag

g.title: reply
g.text: reply SLUG (after ask): append the explanation

g.title: stop
g.text: Done: nothing waits; the queue is presented; stop.

g.title: actions
g.text: the in-progress record is gone; the action finished or was abandoned
the path is declared, listed under outside:, or an approved retention or restoration names it
Fixed by names a commit that changes no Agreed text; REQ has a current passing receipt after it
the in-progress record names the action, or PATH is clean
the named record reads under its grammar; nothing else changed
a current receipt for REQ exists: input set, declaration and text digests equal now
a current passing receipt for REQ; the reviewed list carries REQ with a fail receipt
three attempts without a pass: an escalation names REQ before a fourth
the reviewed list carries REQ with the current text digest and a fail receipt; no code changed
the item carries Outside because:, or an escalation names it
the review names the current input set digest, answers every fixed question, no finding open
no finding is open; each resolution its own commit
brief issued (cairn brief); the agent starts the adversary and waits; a report names the review's and the brief's digests, answers every claim by name, and every answer and finding is carried
Realized by names a commit that resolves
a Consequential decision names the item; a commitment naming only Agreed requirements; Current: moved; the item stamped

g.title: escalate
g.text: the next wake says Escalate, then Waiting
